en_title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation Producer Yoshinori Kitase Hints That Square Enix is Interested in Movie Adaptations and New Games
cn_title: 《最终幻想7 Revelation》制作人北濑佳范暗示史克威尔艾尼克斯对电影改编和新游戏感兴趣
opus_summary: 《最终幻想7 重制版》三部曲制作人北濑佳范对未来推出更多《最终幻想》影视改编持乐观态度，并表示公司更可能投资新作品和新游戏，但也可能重制旧作。《Final Fantasy VII Revelation》将于2027年4月28日发售。

paragraphs.en: Yoshinori Kitase, producer of the Final Fantasy VII Remake Trilogy and director of the original Final Fantasy VII, was optimistic about the possibility of more movie adaptations for Final Fantasy games and hinted that Square Enix is likely interested in pursuing original IP moving forward.
paragraphs.cn: 《最终幻想7 重制版》三部曲制作人、初版《最终幻想7》导演北濑佳范对《最终幻想》系列游戏推出更多电影改编作品的可能性持乐观态度，并暗示史克威尔艾尼克斯今后可能有意开发原创IP。

paragraphs.en: It seems like every major video game developer is hawking out their IP for TV and film adaptations these days. And, for the most part, many of these have been quite successful: Zach Cregger’s Resident Evil movie has become one of the most profitable horror films of all time, and the Sonic film franchise is so popular that a fourth movie is on the way.
paragraphs.cn: 如今，似乎每家大型电子游戏开发商都在兜售自家的IP，以便改编成电视剧和电影。而其中许多作品大体上都相当成功：扎克·克雷格执导的《生化危机》电影已成为有史以来盈利最高的恐怖片之一，《刺猬索尼克》电影系列也十分受欢迎，第四部电影已经在路上。

paragraphs.en: One developer that’s been notably absent from this trend is Square Enix. While the Final Fantasy games have had their fair share of adaptations over the years to mixed reception from fans ( The Spirits Within is a good movie, dammit, and I’ll die on this hill), we haven’t seen one on the big screen in quite some time.
paragraphs.cn: 有一家开发商在这股潮流中明显缺席，那就是史克威尔艾尼克斯。虽然《最终幻想》系列游戏多年来有过不少改编作品，粉丝的反应褒贬不一（《最终幻想：灵魂深处》是一部好电影，该死，我会坚持这个观点到底），但我们已经有相当长一段时间没有在大银幕上看到过一部了。

paragraphs.en: IGN’s Michael Peyton got the chance to speak with Yoshinori Kitase at the Lucca Comics & Games Festival 2026, where he asked about Square Enix’s plans for future movies. And while Kitase couldn’t tell us much, his response was optimistic.
paragraphs.cn: IGN的Michael Peyton在2026年Lucca Comics & Games Festival上有机会与北濑佳范交谈，并询问了史克威尔艾尼克斯未来的电影计划。虽然北濑无法透露太多，但他的回应是乐观的。

paragraphs.en: “Given the fact that we created this game, the remake of Final Fantasy VII, which explored the world of Final Fantasy VII way more than the original version, I think that it would be nice to have in the future games or TV series inspired by the story of Final Fantasy. And I don't see why that should not be a possibility in the future,” he answered.
paragraphs.cn: 他回答说：「考虑到我们制作了《最终幻想7》的重制版这款游戏，它对《最终幻想7》世界的探索比原版深入得多，我认为未来能有受《最终幻想》故事启发而创作的游戏或电视剧会很不错。我也看不出为什么未来不可能出现这样的作品。」

paragraphs.en: What’s more, Kitase also seemed to be under the impression that Square Enix is likely to pivot its focus toward more original stories and IP, following the massive effort that is the Final Fantasy VII Remake trilogy .
paragraphs.cn: 此外，北濑似乎还认为，在投入巨大精力打造《最终幻想7 重制版》三部曲之后，史克威尔艾尼克斯可能会将重心转向更多原创故事和IP。

paragraphs.en: “I think that mainly, we are more likely to invest in new titles and new games, but at the same time, for example, this time with the [Final Fantasy VII] remake, there was me and other creators who worked on the original game, which we had really strong feelings towards,” he said. “And we really wanted to create something new related to the old game to allow new users to play and to know the appeal of this game as much as the old users who play the old game. So there might be different cases like this one where the company is willing to invest in remaking old projects and other kinds of games like it happened this time.”
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「我认为总体而言，我们更有可能投资新作品和新游戏，但与此同时，比如这次的《最终幻想7》重制版，我和其他参与过原版游戏的创作者都对它有着非常深厚的感情。我们非常想创作一些与旧游戏相关的新内容，让新玩家能够玩到这款游戏，并像玩过旧游戏的老玩家一样了解它的魅力。所以，也许还会有像这次一样的不同情况，公司愿意投资重制旧项目和其他类型的游戏。」

paragraphs.en: The third and final game in the Remake trilogy, Final Fantasy VII Revelation , releases on April 28, 2027 on PlayStation 5, Xbox X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC. For more information about the game, check out our hands-on preview from October, where we got the chance to play a section early and get a better feel for what the next chapter of Cloud’s journey will be like. You can read our full interview with Yoshinori Kitase here.
paragraphs.cn: 重制版三部曲的第三部、也是最后一部游戏《最终幻想7 Revelation》将于2027年4月28日登陆PS5、XBOX X|S、Switch 2和PC。有关该游戏的更多信息，请查看我们10月的上手前瞻；当时我们有机会提前游玩其中一个片段，更深入地了解Cloud旅程的下一章将会是什么样子。你可以在这里阅读我们对北濑佳范的完整采访。
